name: ETF资金异动
description_zh: 本Skill基于广发证券权威数据接口构建，支持查询大幅流入、大幅流出、持续流入、持续流出超级资金异动ETF及近14日资金明细，跟踪ETF资金异动、研判市场资金方向。
description_en: GF Securities ETF super fund flow anomaly detection tool, supporting queries for major inflows, major outflows, continuous inflows, and continuous outflows with 14-day fund flow details. Track ETF capital anomalies and assess market fund direction.
